summary: Alphega Innovations Corp filed an 8-K disclosing executive employment agreements with its CEO and COO, approved by disinterested directors. The agreements set terms through 2028, with no fixed cash salary, performance bonuses up to 50% of salary, and annual equity grants of 500,000 shares each. No change in control, merger, or special-situation event is involved. The filing is a routine compensation disclosure, not a special situation. Board approval by disinterested members reflects standard governance. No deal terms apply.
